Hi Marissa / Neha — looping in answers below and attaching the two artifacts we can share without an NDA.

Attachments included:
- Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2025.pdf (redacted summary of the latest external pen test; sensitive IOA and exploit details removed)
- Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_FinHealth.xlsx (completed where applicable; see notes tab)

Bullet summary for FinHealth security (please feel free to copy):
- SOC 2: Redwood Inference maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation covering our security and availability controls for our hosted service. We can provide the SOC 2 attestation letter and summary report under a standard NDA; a redacted attestation summary is available upon request.
- HIPAA/GDPR: We support HIPAA-compliant deployments and offer a BAA for customers handling PHI. We also provide a GDPR DPA and data processing details on request.
- Pen test / vuln mgmt:
  - External pentests: annual third-party penetration tests; most recent summary attached (2025).
  - Internal scans: authenticated vulnerability scans run weekly across production instances; unauthenticated external scans run nightly for surface-level issues.
  - Remediation SLAs (standard): Critical (CVSS >= 9.0): remediation or mitigations within 30 calendar days; High (7.0-8.9): remediation within 90 calendar days; Medium (4.0-6.9): remediation within 180 calendar days; Low (<4.0): tracked for future releases. Escalation paths are documented and will be shared with customers under a sharing agreement.
  - Disclosure policy: Redwood coordinates disclosure with impacted customers and third parties. We do not publicly disclose customer-impacting vulnerabilities without prior remediation or coordinated disclosure. Where public disclosure is required, standard practice is to provide 30 days notice and a redacted summary.
- Redaction and NDA: The attached pen test summary is redacted — we can provide a less-redacted copy under a mutual NDA. For customers requiring full technical detail (e.g., procurement/legal teams), we recommend an NDA before sharing full report data.

If FinHealth confirms they prefer a redacted summary we can share the attached immediately. If they want the full report, we can route the NDA and post-signature deliverable. Additionally, if there are specific questionnaire items that need deeper detail, let me know and we can provide follow-up comments.

Rgds,
Rishi Malhotra
